name: Get Off My Lawn Brainrots
desc:
🏠 Welcome to Get Off My Lawn Brainrots!

How to Play:
🛡️ Buy a defender and place it on your porch!
⚔️ Your defenders fight brainrots for you!
💸 Brainrots generate you money!
🔥 Buy better defenders to defeat rarer brainrots!
✨ Rebirth to improve your luck!

👍 Like the game and join the group!
